result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
The best HR software for a small company depends on whether you primarily need employee management, payroll, recruiting, time-off tracking, or all of them.

**My recommendation: BambooHR for HR management, or Humi for a Canadian small business that wants HR and payroll together.**

If you're running a company with roughly 5–50 employees, I'd shortlist these platforms\:

## Best HR software for small businesses

![Humi | Avalon Accounting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aV3Tyz3-tu3Ua2Xm7WVQBpO1H00xNsE-uXVcxB6M3lZP2UWvHC2vLiEka8eGc6XXEcdljGfg21UMFEqFlr78cWjUpXEuhL40GY9156cDo8EGOuPvuaoz_8cStG_lJOHgN8zNS0RU3dLB24rMLdae3OnVeR8Ge471ucjOzOJdl93ilCYmtpNgcfVfOTm8qiEd?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Humi (Employment Hero)**

(Best overall for Canadian businesses)

- HR, payroll, benefits and hiring.
- Canadian payroll, T4s, ROEs and CRA remittances.
- Employee onboarding and self-service.
- Payroll pricing starts around \$7/employee/month, with a \$70 monthly minimum; HR pricing is quote-based.

Best if you want one system for most HR responsibilities.

[Employment Hero Canada](https://employmenthero.com/ca/)

---

![Employee Training | Collage HR](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5wSAh1zF7cOfQF-9kYM8MwPGxvypkAHz3Ry1sgIYNSu5OO9C-RY9O9eRCh7ll4QXL8yue9eTsJF0CjgZP0dq8DOpSocmPERwxs-iCl8J2tXO4OEZp1oCS6zqrl0Ri7n3QtmVBm5XyYosjmaifpm91pe9EJLMusxsniBCi4QedBlpg9uKepjGwHHtwuPY72et?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Collage HR**

(Best all-in-one value)

- Employee records and onboarding.
- Vacation and time-off tracking.
- Performance reviews and recruiting.
- Payroll, T4s and CRA remittances.

**Published pricing\:** C\$14/employee/month for HR; C\$18 for HR and payroll.

[Collage HR pricing](https://www.collage.co/pricing)

---

![Rise People Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) - Brandfetch](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/7HKTOKZD4Kq-JSMPhRhcNTlQA7rJi42jZpzOcWVvO8Vp2hJT6Rhh0oGTBMEeCSQ0lDwB83guD9vClgp8bcNuXqCxl7LvZ0oelOg6dh02GU5ngsYOlj6VR7zCfu9A_yotM3v49K8O7ARuS699LbAQ42gyh0Owu2O6wFYYjsek-DIjBn-8ZWROeh42pjnkIQD8?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rise People**

(Best for HR and benefits integration)

- HR administration and payroll.
- Benefits management.
- Employee onboarding and time off.
- Good option for growing Canadian teams.

Pricing starts around C\$8/employee/month, plus a base fee.

[Rise People website](https://risepeople.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. BambooHR**

(Best for employee management)

- Excellent employee database.
- Hiring and onboarding.
- Performance management.
- Time-off tracking and reporting.

Canadian pricing starts at approximately C\$14.40/employee/month for larger teams, with a C\$360 monthly starting rate for 25 or fewer employees. Canadian payroll requires a separate solution or integration.

[BambooHR Canada](https://www.bamboohr.com/ca/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Rippling**

(Best for rapid growth)

- HR, payroll and IT management.
- Automated employee onboarding and offboarding.
- Software and device management.
- Useful for companies with employees in multiple countries.

Pricing is customized.

[Rippling Canada](https://www.rippling.com/en-CA/)

These recommendations reflect current 2026 comparisons and Canadian pricing information. [rankite.com](https://rankite.com/blog/best-hr-software-for-small-business-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.collage.co](https://www.collage.co/pricing?locale=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bamboohr.com](https://www.bamboohr.com/ca/pricing/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.rippling.com](https://www.rippling.com/en-CA/blog/best-hr-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a small Canadian company, I'd narrow it down this way\:

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| All-in-one HR and payroll | Humi / Employment Hero |
| Best published pricing | Collage HR |
| Employee management and reviews | BambooHR |
| HR, benefits and payroll | Rise People |
| International growth and automation | Rippling |


One important consideration: don't choose a US-focused platform just because it looks inexpensive. Canadian payroll needs to handle CRA remittances, CPP, EI, T4s and Records of Employment.

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
